name: push

description.en: Web Push (W-PUSH): a customer (order token), a courier and the venue's owner/kitchen subscribe a browser push endpoint through /api/push/subscribe; the venue's object queues one outbox entry per (event, device) in the turn that changes the order (new order -> staff, a status -> that order's customer, an assignment or READY -> that courier); the drain seals the message with RFC 8291 aes128gcm, signs RFC 8292 VAPID ES256 and posts it to the browser's push service. 404/410 removes the device; a customer's devices are removed when the order ends.
description.uk: Push-сповіщення: клієнт, кур'єр і власник/кухня підписують браузер; при зміні замовлення хаб шифрує повідомлення (RFC 8291), підписує VAPID (RFC 8292) і надсилає його через push-сервіс браузера.

producer.what: owed(): which devices an order event owes, written into the outbox by hubdo/push_turn.rs in the same object turn
deliver(): encrypt (ece.rs), sign (vapid.rs), POST to the endpoint; classify 2xx/404/410/400/413/other

consumer.what: the service worker's 'push' handler shows {title, body}; 'notificationclick' opens url
turnOn(): permission on the tap, pushManager.subscribe with the VAPID key, POST /api/push/subscribe

headers: Authorization: vapid t=<ES256 JWT>, k=<public key>

external: Web Push Protocol RFC 8030 + RFC 8291 + RFC 8292; push services FCM/Mozilla autopush/Apple

secrets: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY (Worker secret; the pair of notify/push/vapid.rs PUBLIC_KEY, kept on the box in /root/.dowiz_vapid)

message_schema.description: the DECRYPTED push payload the device receives

probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-push.mjs: a REAL Mozilla autopush subscription (WebSocket hello/register with our VAPID key) is subscribed as the owner and as the customer of a TEST order (LIVE-<run>) on qa-durres; placing it must deliver 'New order' to the owner device and confirming it 'Confirmed' to the customer device, read back DECRYPTED with the probe's own key; optionally the QA hub courier hears an assignment; the order is cancelled and the owner device unsubscribed at the end. A probe that receives nothing is FAILED.
